 Advertisement Updated: 9:37 AM CDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Taylor Lang Digital Content Manager LIVE: Watch the 2026 Brewers World Series Championship parade
 Updated: 9:37 AM CDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Taylor Lang Digital Content Manager MILWAUKEE — MAKING HISTORY | MERCHANDISE | SCHOOL CLOSURES | MVP | REACTION | MKE GIVEAWAYS 
 Brewers make history! Brew Crew, now is the time to celebrate our first World Series title. 
 Advertisement The parade is starting at 10 a.m. and thousands of fans are gathered. There are people on roofs, hanging out of windows and in the streets.
 The championship parade will start the intersection of North 4th Street and West Wisconsin Avenue. It will go through downtown Milwaukee before concluding at Henry Maier Festival Park (HMFP), where a rally will take place throughout the grounds.
 Watch the live stream showing different views of the parade in the video player below. 
 Admission to the general Summerfest grounds is be free to all fans until capacity is reached.
